mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_CODE, BOARD_NM, USE_ANSWER, USE_COMMENT, USE_NOTICE, USE_SECRET FROM TB_COMMON_BOARD WHERE BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode}

WITH RECURSIVE POST_TREE AS ( SELECT tp.BOARD_CODE, tp.POST_CODE, tp.POST_NM, tp.POST_INFO, tp.NOTICE_CHECK, tp.UPPER_CODE, tp.DETHP, tp.VIEW_COUNT, tp.SECRET_CHECK, tp.INSERT_USER_ID, tp.INSERT_DT, tp.COMMENT_CHECK, tp.ANSWER_CHECK, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT tc WHERE tp.POST_CODE = tc.POST_CODE) AS COMMENT_CNT, TO_CHAR(tp.POST_CODE, 'FM0000000000') AS PATH FROM TB_POST tp WHERE BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode} AND UPPER_CODE = 0
UNION ALL SELECT p.BOARD_CODE, p.POST_CODE, p.POST_NM, p.POST_INFO, p.NOTICE_CHECK, p.UPPER_CODE, p.DETHP, p.VIEW_COUNT, p.SECRET_CHECK, p.INSERT_USER_ID, p.INSERT_DT, p.COMMENT_CHECK, p.ANSWER_CHECK, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COMMENT tc WHERE p.POST_CODE = tc.POST_CODE) AS COMMENT_CNT, pt.PATH || '-' || TO_CHAR(p.POST_CODE, 'FM0000000000') AS PATH FROM TB_POST p JOIN POST_TREE pt ON p.UPPER_CODE = pt.POST_CODE WHERE p.BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode} ) SELECT * FROM POST_TREE ORDER BY PATH;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_POST ( POST_CODE, BOARD_CODE, POST_NM, POST_INFO, NOTICE_CHECK, UPPER_CODE, DETHP, VIEW_COUNT, SECRET_CHECK, COMMENT_CHECK, ANSWER_CHECK, INSERT_USER_ID, INSERT_DT ) VALUES ( #{postCode}, #{boardCode}, #{postNm}, #{postInfo}, #{noticeCheck}, #{upperCode}, #{dethp}, #{viewCount}, #{secretCheck}, #{commentCheck}, #{answerCheck}, #{insertUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO TB_POST_FILE ( POST_CODE, SAVE_FILE_NM, FILE_NM, FILE_SIZE, INSERT_USER_ID, INSERT_DT ) VALUES ( #{postCode}, #{saveFileNm}, #{fileNm}, #{fileSize}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT POST_CODE, BOARD_CODE, POST_NM, POST_INFO, NOTICE_CHECK, UPPER_CODE, DETHP, VIEW_COUNT, COMMENT_CHECK, ANSWER_CHECK, INSERT_USER_ID, INSERT_DT FROM TB_POST WHERE POST_CODE = #{postCode}
SELECT POST_CODE, FILE_NO, SAVE_FILE_NM, FILE_NM, FILE_SIZE FROM TB_POST_FILE WHERE POST_CODE = #{postCode}
SELECT FILE_NO, SAVE_FILE_NM, FILE_NM FROM TB_POST_FILE WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}

WITH RECURSIVE COMMENT_TREE AS ( SELECT COMMENT_CODE, POST_CODE, COMMENT_CONTENT, UPPER_CODE, DETHP, INSERT_USER_ID, INSERT_DT, TO_CHAR(COMMENT_CODE, 'FM0000000000') AS PATH FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE POST_CODE = #{postCode} AND UPPER_CODE = 0
UNION ALL SELECT c.COMMENT_CODE, c.POST_CODE, c.COMMENT_CONTENT, c.UPPER_CODE, c.DETHP, c.INSERT_USER_ID, c.INSERT_DT, ct.PATH || '-' || TO_CHAR(c.COMMENT_CODE, 'FM0000000000') AS PATH FROM TB_COMMENT c JOIN COMMENT_TREE ct ON c.UPPER_CODE = ct.COMMENT_CODE WHERE c.POST_CODE = #{postCode} ) SELECT * FROM COMMENT_TREE ORDER BY PATH;
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT ( POST_CODE, COMMENT_CONTENT, UPPER_CODE, DETHP, INSERT_USER_ID, INSERT_DT ) VALUES ( #{postCode}, #{commentContent}, #{upperCode}, #{dethp}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT POST_CODE, COMMENT_CODE, DETHP FROM TB_COMMENT WHERE COMMENT_CODE = #{commentCode}
